QuestInfo.name: Red Mystic Gate
QuestInfo.0: Huckle's eyes were sparkling when you told him about the red Mystic Gate. Go talk to him again to see what he's up to.
QuestInfo.1: Go take a look at the red Mystic Gate again.
QuestInfo.2: The red Mystic Gate exploded when you touched it!

0.0: This is a strange turn of events. What would it turn red?

yes.0: Go back to the Mystic Gate and take another look.

no.0: Aren't you curious to see what happened?

1.0: The red gate reacted to your touch with a torrent of energy.

npc.0: Please go back to Orbis Tower <16th Floor> and check into the Mystic Gate that turned red.
